<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/move_workflow/{project_guid}/{workflow_guid}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Moves a workflow, without its git history, into another project: the
destination's hub gains it in one commit (with any library versions its
nodes link that the destination lacks), the source's loses it in
another, both propagate to every clone, and the runtime reloads both
projects. The workflow and node guids stay the same.

Refused while the workflow is running or has messages queued. References
to project variables the destination doesn't define are reported in
`missing_variables` and don't stop the move. With `dry_run`, only checks
and reports.
